Deem-lhe do fruto das suas mãos, e que as suas obras a louvem nas portas.

kjv.texto: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.

vizinhos.28: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
vizinhos.30: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the Lord, she shall be praised.
